verdict_reason: Correct and tested, but the connect-timeout rule has a different home here than in the twin animals and plants frontends.

todos.issue: The one-second happy-eyeballs connect setting lives in a new connect-attempt.js called from src/index.js, while the twin frontends set the same rule inside startServer (repos/trade-imports-animals-frontend/src/server/common/helpers/start-server.js:1-8, trade-imports-plants-frontend the same) and pin it in start-server.test.js. The house rule is one owner per rule, mirrored in each twin repo; the inc-067 plan also says the INS startServer gains the setting 'the same way'. Three frontends now hold one rule in two different homes.

One way: either fold allowOneSecondPerAddressWhenConnecting into INS startServer as the twins do, or keep connect-attempt.js here and move the animals and plants frontends to the same helper called from their index.js in the same theme.
